headline: High: ChatGPT Desktop can ingest files/screenshots while plano has broad egress, creating a default path for prompt injection, data leakage, and unverified downstream actions.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop reads uploaded files, screenshots, and supported-app content by default, while plano exposes an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint with broad egress. If plano forwards or renders ChatGPT output without provenance checks, attacker-controlled content can be reinterpreted as instructions. The pairwise bridge is plausible from the profiles, though not explicitly documented.
conditions: IF plano ingests ChatGPT-generated text into a prompt template without escaping
IF ChatGPT Desktop reads attacker-supplied files or screenshots that plano later reuses as instructions
mitigations: Add explicit instruction/data delimiters in plano prompts
Strip or escape markup before passing ChatGPT output onward
Require a human review step before acting on model output
Use separate workspaces for raw inputs and generated instructions

B_data_leakage.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected-IDE code, and plano has broad network egress plus an OpenAI-compatible API surface. That creates a realistic path for sensitive content from ChatGPT to be relayed outward through plano in default workflows. The profiles do not show a blocking isolation boundary, so uncertainty pushes this to high.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop is given sensitive uploads or screenshots
IF plano forwards those contents or derived summaries to its upstream API
mitigations: Disable forwarding of raw file contents in plano
Redact secrets before any API call
Use a separate non-sensitive workspace for ChatGPT inputs
Turn off clipboard-based transfer between the agents
Add a manual approval gate for outbound requests

C_capability_conflict.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop has no filesystem write, git modify, or shell execution, while plano exposes only config-file I/O and an API endpoint. There is little direct write-write overlap, so conflict risk is limited. Because both can touch files or prompts in the same workflow, a small coordination issue remains, but the blast radius is modest.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same config or prompt files
IF plano mutates config.yaml while ChatGPT Desktop reads or summarizes it
mitigations: Assign separate directories per agent
Make config.yaml read-only during analysis
Serialize edits through one operator
Use version control diffs before applying changes

D_cascading_error.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can produce summaries from files and screenshots, and plano can consume model outputs through its chat-completions interface. If plano treats ChatGPT output as authoritative, errors can cascade into downstream routing or travel-planning decisions. The profiles show no built-in verification step, so the interaction exists in default workflows.
conditions: IF plano uses ChatGPT output as a source of truth without validation
IF ChatGPT summarizes ambiguous screenshots or files
mitigations: Require source citations before plano acts
Cross-check ChatGPT outputs against original files
Add a second-pass verifier prompt
Block automatic execution of plano decisions

E_compliance.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected-IDE code, while plano stores logs, traces, and metrics and has broad egress. If regulated or personal data flows from ChatGPT into plano telemetry, retention and residency obligations can diverge. The profiles do not specify matching compliance controls, so the safer choice is medium.
conditions: IF regulated personal data is present in ChatGPT inputs
IF plano logs or exports that data to its telemetry or upstream services
mitigations: Exclude sensitive fields from logs
Shorten retention on plano telemetry
Use synthetic test data for paired runs
Document a data-flow review before deployment
